title: Novaplex
description: Long-running premium Java survival server with lightweight QoL features, no pay-to-win or intrusive systems, built for technical & building gameplay.
body:
## 中文
### 本服采用多世界架构，为不同游戏偏好的玩家提供针对性环境
- 折纸银河：死亡不掉落，适合休闲养老、建筑创作
- 清醒梦境：增强地形生成与结构分布，探索感更强
### 核心功能
提供季节变化、领地保护、商店、拍卖行、称号系统等，无复杂体系，无付费特权，无广告干扰
### 适合人群
长期生电玩家、大型建筑党，以及追求稳定、纯粹游戏环境的技术向玩家

## English
### This server runs parallel survival worlds tailored to different playstyles
- Casual: KeepInventory enabled for relaxed building and casual gameplay
- Epic: Enhanced terrain generation and structure distribution for exploration-focused gameplay
### Features
Light enhancements including seasons, land claims,player shops, auction house, and cosmetic titles. Intentionally minimal: no complex systems, no pay-to-win mechanics, and no advertisements.
### Target Audience
Players focused on technical Minecraft (redstone/farms) and large-scale builds who want a stable, distraction-free environment.
